lemmas.statement: S_g and T_g are polynomial automorphisms with explicit triangular inverses and preserve the standard symplectic form.
On the cone, the S phase selects q1^g in the first gradient row and q1^2*q2^2 in the second, giving A_g.
After v=A_g*u, the T phase selects p1^2*p2^2 in the first row and p2^g in the second, giving B_g.
The ratio map preserves the half-open cone for every integer g>=5 and the full degree vector strictly grows.
Positive integer coefficients in characteristic zero and strict face gaps prevent leading cancellation.
The exact complete-step recurrence is u_(n+1)=C_g*u_n and q2 observes total degree.
The characteristic polynomial of C_g has roots (sqrt(g)+1)^2 and (sqrt(g)-1)^2, so the positive Perron root is the dynamical degree.
